author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Routes selected alerts and cross-platform viewer TTS requests through one bounded Speaker.bot queue with an optional avatar and progressive-text overlay.
changelog: 3.0.0: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 3.0.0, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.6.1: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 2.6.1, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial safe rebuild with alert-first allowlist, role-gated chat, local filtering, bounded queue, link stripping, and creator pause/resume/stop controls.

manifest.name: Village Voice
installationSteps: Import Village Voice, approve only Speak, and test a harmless phrase.
For Twitch and Kick, attach the matching native Reward Redemption trigger to the existing platform intake.
For YouTube and TikTok, create the configured no-response command in Command Sync and enable Viewer Foundation points.
Add /overlay/addons/thsv.voice-relay as a browser source for the optional speaking card.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall Village Voice. It retains no spoken text history.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded filtered Speaker.bot dispatch and viewer-request routing are available.
